script.problem: "the Sabbath" and "My suffering" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
It has 22 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.

terra.problem: The verses do not say that Judas acted because the priests and scribes feared the people. Judas discussed the betrayal with the chief priests and temple officers, not explicitly with the scribes.
The cited verses do not identify those addressed as the apostles. In the indirect retelling, “My suffering” should be “His suffering.”
The cited verses say Jesus took the cup and described it as the new covenant; they do not say He gave it to them.
